name: Sunset Angels
source:
A former volleyball star, forced to leave the court after an injury, suddenly gets a message that changes everything. It’s from an old friend — now the director of a small sports center in a quiet coastal town called Sunborn Bay. He offers the protagonist a chance to become a coach. A new life. A new beginning. Sunborn Bay isn’t just beaches and golden sunsets — it breathes volleyball. And in the middle of summer, our protagonist becomes the reluctant coach of an all-girls volleyball team. But things aren’t as easy as they seemed. The team is in disarray. Some girls don’t take him seriously. Others keep fighting among themselves. One is talented but lazy. Another lacks confidence. And above it all — rumors. No one wants to talk about what really happened to the previous coach. And something dark is looming over the sports center... hungry rivals who would love to see it fall. Can the protagonist pull the girls together? Can he rebuild the team, win their trust, and maybe... find something more than just purpose?

[From [url=https://catfish-studio.itch.io/sunset-angels]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位前排球明星因伤被迫离开球场，突然收到一条改变一切的消息。这是一位老朋友发来的，他现在是一个名为森博恩湾的安静沿海小镇的一个小型体育中心的主任。他为主角提供了成为教练的机会。新的生活。一个新的开始。森伯恩湾不仅有海滩和金色的日落，还有排球的气息。在盛夏，我们的主角不情愿地成为了一支女子排球队的教练。但事情并不像看上去那么容易。球队一片混乱。有些女孩不把他当回事。其他人则继续互相争斗。一个人很有才华，但很懒。另一个缺乏信心。最重要的是——谣言。没有人愿意谈论前任教练到底发生了什么。体育中心上空笼罩着某种黑暗的气息……饥饿的对手们希望看到它倒下。主角能把女孩们团结起来吗？他能否重建球队，赢得他们的信任，也许……找到比目标更重要的东西？
